channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: School roof collapses in northwestern Pakistan, killing at least 29 people
item.description: At least 28 students and one teacher killed in incident at Al-Khair Education Centre, a private school in Peshawar.

item.title: Containers and debris captured floating around the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Video shows containers and debris scattered around the Strait of Hormuz due to the recent attacks on vessels.

item.title: Russian nuclear-powered submarine fires missiles during Pacific drills
item.description: Russia's Pacific Fleet has test-fired cruise missiles from a nuclear-powered submarine, striking a target 1,200km away.

item.title: G20 finance ministers, central bankers gather amid fallout from Iran war
item.description: Officials meet in Thailand as conflict drives energy prices higher and casts uncertainty over global economy.

item.title: Albanian Ministry of Justice on fire as education protesters riot
item.description: Hundreds of students joined anti-government protests in Tirana, demanding education reforms.

item.title: North Korea tests two submarine-launched missiles, state media reports
item.description: The tests showcase North Korea's war deterrent capabilities in the region, KCNA says.
